Elliot: Hey everyone — I'm Elliot, joining as ML Engineer on the inference infra team. Super excited to be here! I'll be starting Monday (remote, PST). Quick q: where do I find the onboarding checklist? :wave:

welcome-bot: Welcome, Elliot! We've added you to the #new-hires roster. Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/elliot. Please complete items 1-3 before your first day.

Sophie: Welcome!! :tada: I'm Sophie (eng-infra). Ping me any time for infra walkthroughs. Coffee chat tomorrow 10:00 AM PT? I'll put a calendar invite on your email.

Rahul: hey elliot, welcome 👋 (Rahul, eng-runtime). we usually run a quick perf pairing sesh in week 1 — LMK when you're free. also lunch crew meets weds for tacos :taco:

Megan: hi! Megan here from DevEx. i'll DM you a slack hq guide + primer on our dev flow. pro tip: check the onboarding scripts in the repo, they save time :sparkles:

Ciara: Welcome! People Ops will sort swag — @people-ops can help with sizes. also there's a sticker treasure map in the kitchen fridge if you're in-office :eyes: :stuck_out_tongue:

Elliot: Thanks y'all — super helpful. Sophie 10am works for me. looking forward to pairing, Rahul. I'll go through the checklist tonight. :coffee:

Sophie: Added you to the invite. One more thing — if you want a repo walkthrough i'm free right after the coffee chat. :balloon:
